_comment: Machine presets and study definitions for scaling.py.  Only gadi_h200 has been exercised; the others are best-effort launch lines -- expect to adjust the launcher/env on first contact.  {nodes} {ranks} {tpn} {bin} {args} are substituted.

weak._comment: Fixed work per rank: the slab is k columns x ny cells, global columns = k * ranks, dx = 1 m throughout.  Ideal: flat time per step.

strong._comment: Fixed global mesh.  Global columns = min_cols_per_rank * ranks(largest node count), so the last point still has min_cols_per_rank columns per rank (ghost fraction ~ 2/min_cols).  Smallest node count is set by device memory.

frontier.modules_hint: module load PrgEnv-amd amd/10.0.0 rocm/10.0.0  (no craype-accel-amd-gfx90a: it links GTL built for ROCm 6)
frontier._comment: Verified on Frontier 2026-10-05: amdgpumpi compiles/links with the setup modules. 8 ranks x 7 cores = the 56 cores left by Frontier's default -S 8 core spec; --gpus-per-task=1 --gpu-bind=closest gives each rank its own GCD (ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES), so rank %% omp_get_num_devices() picks device 0. No -q needed (batch is default; debug QOS is <=2 h).

aurora.modules_hint: default Aurora PE (oneapi/release/2026.1.0, mpich/prd/5.0.0); no extra modules needed
aurora._comment: Built on an Aurora login node 2026-10-06 (icx 2026.1.0, mpich 5.0.0, default PE): ldd clean, 1-rank CPU smoke OK; GPU runs not yet verified. 12 ranks/node, one per PVC tile: gpu_tile_compact.sh (on PATH, /opt/aurora/<ver>/support/tools/mpi_wrapper_utils) sets ZE_AFFINITY_MASK per local rank, so each rank sees one device. The cpu-bind list is ALCF's: 8 cores per rank, skipping the OS cores 0 and 52, ranks 0-5 on socket 0. Halo is staged through host, so MPI never sees device pointers (MPIR_CVAR_ENABLE_GPU=0). Queues: debug 1-2 nodes, debug-scaling 2-256, prod 256+; all 1 h max except prod. NOTE: emit writes '#PBS -l wd' (gadi only); delete it from Aurora scripts.

gadi_v100.modules_hint: gadi gpuvolta: 4 x V100-32GB per node
